hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes Uniswap v4 swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. The beforeSwap hook computes quotes via a custom bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the normal concentrated liquidity mechanism. Concentrated liquidity positions and donations are intentionally blocked.
